claim_under_test: source-reconnaissance.md section 5 table: sa.wikisource gana pages carry notation in 'real Unicode Vedic Extensions, not a font hack'

verdict.why: 98.09% of the cantillation marks are in DEVANAGARI EXTENDED U+A8E0-U+A8F1 (106,094 of 108,160); only 1.91% (2,066) are Vedic Extensions tone marks U+1CD0 and U+1CD2. A validator or extractor scoped to the Vedic Extensions block would find 2,066 tone marks and miss 106,094. (The Vedic Extensions block holds 2,200 characters here, but 134 of them are U+1CF2 ARDHAVISARGA, a spacing sign and not a tone.) The project's own data/canonical/samaveda_arcika_v1/source_artifacts.jsonl already recorded the correct block -- 'Devanagari Extended U+A8E1-U+A8E5' -- so it is the reconnaissance table that drifted, not the project's knowledge.

deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+A8F2: DEVANAGARI SIGN SPACING CANDRABINDU, category Lo. A nasal LETTER. Occurs 162 times. Counting it as tone inflates the count and stripping it corrupts the text.
deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+A8F3: DEVANAGARI SIGN CANDRABINDU VIRAMA, category Lo. The Samavedic nasal. Occurs 1,722 times. Same hazard.
deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+1CF2: VEDIC SIGN ARDHAVISARGA, category Lo, 134 occurrences. A sign, not a tone.
deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+1CEA: VEDIC SIGN ANUSVARA BAHIRGOMUKHA - anusvara, not tone. 0 occurrences here.
deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+1CEC: VEDIC SIGN ANUSVARA VAMAGOMUKHA WITH TAIL - anusvara, not tone. 0 here.
deliberate_exclusions_tested_by_meaning_.U+0301: COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT - udatta in IAST AND the s-acute consonant in transliteration. 0 occurrences in this Devanagari witness, so the ambiguity does not fire; excluded anyway so it cannot fire later.

notation_the_codepoint_census_cannot_see.finding: A large part of Kauthuma notation is written INLINE as ordinary Devanagari or ASCII digits after an avagraha, e.g. प्रचो꣢ऽ१२१२ - the melodic figure 1-2-1-2. These are U+0967..U+096F, not combining marks.
notation_the_codepoint_census_cannot_see.consequence: Counting combining marks alone UNDERSTATES the notation. This is the same failure mode as counting a codepoint instead of testing meaning, in the opposite direction.

private_use_defects_located.note: Isolated transcription slips, not an architecture. On the 662 gana pages there are 3; the rest are on the three ancillary word-list pages.
